item.semiconductor-lab.mercury_thermomet: A thermometer of mercury in a thin glass tube. Right-click for air temperature; sneak and right-click for body temperature.
2 soda-lime glass + mercury (iron flask returned). ⚠ GHS: mercury - acute toxicity, organ damage (do not breathe the vapour if it breaks).
Warmed mercury expands and climbs the thin tube; the bore is so narrow that a tiny expansion moves visibly. Clinical thermometers have a constriction so the reading stays after you take it out.

Fahrenheit made the mercury thermometer in 1714. Until Thomas Allbutt in England made a short clinical thermometer in 1866, doctors' thermometers were about 30 cm long and took 20 minutes. Most today are electronic (thermistors) without mercury.
Approximation: the air temperature is a game value from the biome temperature; body temperature is approximated as 36.5-37.0 °C.
